tool.name: Train ExoDeepFinder

param.name: patch_sizes
param.label: Patch sizes. Can be an integer or a list of the form [patchSizeModel1, patchSizeModel2, ...]. A list enables to train multiple models, each using the previous weights as initialization. For example, with --patch_sizes "[8, 16]": Model1 will use patches of size 8 voxels and Model2 will use patches of 16 voxels and initialize with the Model1 weights. The longest list of the parameters --patch_sizes, --batch_sizes, --random_shifts, --n_epochs and --n_steps will be use to determine the number of trainings ; and shorter lists will be extended with duplicates of their last values (integer parameters are similarly duplicated) to match the number of trainings.
